instruction: Buy me a area rug from amazon within $150 (excluding tax). Only trust sellers I have ordered from in the past.
notes: Fixed the name clash: the knowledge predicate is now (seller-trusted ?s) and the seller objects are past-seller / new-seller, so no object shares a name with a predicate, type or constant. Single-app purchase task: trusted sellers are discovered by listing past product purchases (show_product_purchases) and reading seller_id via show_product of a past-purchased product. search_products is filtered by product_type 'area rug', max_price 150 and the trusted seller_id; only a product satisfying the static sold-by/has-type/priced-within facts can become (found-product). The cart is cleared first so the order contains exactly one item (quantity defaults to 1); address and payment card ids are looked up before place_order. area-rug-2/new-seller exist only to show that an untrusted seller's rug cannot be ordered. supervisor-complete-task carries the ordered product as a non-API task-record parameter so its precondition equals the goal; no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
